en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing an elegant Baroque riverside palace and its surroundings. The top image depicts a long, low palace building with steep mansard roofs and many dormer windows, standing directly on the bank of a wide river with a bridge or terrace projecting over the water. The bottom‑left image shows monumental river stairs with sphinx sculptures flanking the steps that descend to the river, with boats visible on the water. The bottom‑right image presents a garden view of the same palace complex, framed by trees and landscaped flowerbeds. No printed text is visible on the card front.
